get.summary: Get navigation menus for the current user
get.description:
Returns only the menus the authenticated user has permission to see.
The list is filtered server-side using the user's real RBAC permissions —
the client renders whatever it receives without additional permission checks.

**Caching:** The response includes an `ETag` header and `Cache-Control: private, max-age=300`.
On subsequent requests, send the ETag as `If-None-Match`; a `304 Not Modified` response
means the client's cached list is still valid and no body is returned.

The ETag encodes both the menu `version` (bumped when menus change) and a fingerprint
of the user's current permission set, so it correctly invalidates when permissions change.

parameters.name: If-None-Match
parameters.description: ETag from a previous response. Returns 304 if still valid.

200.description: Filtered menu list for the current user

304.description: Not Modified — ETag matches, client cache is current

priority.description: Sort order within section — lower = first.

surfaces.description: UI surfaces where this item appears (e.g. `["sidebar","bottom-nav","search"]`).

MenusResponse.description: Filtered navigation menu list for the current user.

menus.description: Only menus the current user has permission to see, ordered by `section` then `priority`.

version.description:
Monotonically increasing version counter.
Clients should combine with the `ETag` response header for cache validation.

description.example: Prepare milestones for the product launch.

permissions.description: Sorted list of permission names the user holds for this project.

description.example: Can manage all aspects of projects

TaskHistoryEntry.description: A single entry in a task's automatic change history.

actor_id.description: UUID of the user who triggered the change.

actor_name.description: Display name of the actor (resolved from the users table).

changes.description:
Raw event properties — structure varies by event type.
For `task.updated` this typically contains `{ "field": [old, new] }` pairs.

scope.description: Scope as JSON for resource-level permissions

UserPreferencesEmbed.description:
Preferences embedded inside the user object on /auth/me and /auth/login.
Omits `updated_at` — clients that need it should call GET /auth/me/preferences.
